title: Stabilize a smooth section to a differential basis
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings, B a smooth A-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], J an ideal of A, and σ:B→A/J an A-algebra map. There exist an A-algebra A₁ étale over A [def-weil-etale-morphism], an A-algebra D also equipped with a compatible A₁-algebra structure, with D smooth over A₁, and A-algebra maps j:B→D and τ:D→A/J such that τ∘j=σ and the composite A₁→D→A/J is surjective. Moreover there exist n≥0 and elements fᵢ∈D indexed by Fin n, all killed by τ, such that (1⊗dfᵢ) is a basis [def-weil-pbc-free-module] of (A/J)⊗_D Ω[D/A₁] [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], where D acts on A/J through τ. No quotient or étale neighbourhood of D is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the stabilization-data theorem to obtain an etale base extension and a smooth algebra with free reduced differentials. Choose its finite basis, reindexed by Fin n. Apply surjectivity in the smooth conormal sequence, then surjectivity of Cotangent.mk, to lift each basis vector to a section-kernel element. The cotangentComplex_mk formula identifies its differential with the original basis vector.

proof_origin.description: Finite free stabilization split off; basis selection and kernel lifts fully proved.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_smooth_section_differential_basis
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra.Smooth A B] (J : Ideal A) (σ : B →ₐ[A] A ⧸ J) :
    ∃ A₁ : CommAlgCat.{u} A,
      Etale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A A₁))) ∧
      ∃ (D : CommAlgCat.{u} A) (_ : Algebra A₁ D) (_ : IsScalarTower A A₁ D),
        Algebra.Smooth A₁ D ∧
        ∃ (j : B →ₐ[A] D) (τ : D →ₐ[A] A ⧸ J),
          τ.comp j = σ ∧
          Function.Surjective (τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A₁ D)) ∧
          ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → D), (∀ i, τ (f i) = 0) ∧
            letI : Algebra D (A ⧸ J) := τ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
            ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin n) (A ⧸ J) ((A ⧸ J) ⊗[D] KaehlerDifferential A₁ D),
              ∀ i, b i = 1 ⊗ₜ[D] KaehlerDifferential.D A₁ D (f i)
